user.title: EAC Cyprus
user.description: Sign in with your account on the EAC meter-reading portal (meterreading-dso.eac.com.cy). Your smart meter must be registered there.

service_point.title: Choose the supply
service_point.description: Your account has more than one supply. Pick one (add the integration again for the others).

billing.title: Billing period
billing.description:
Supply: {address}

EAC bills every two months. Look at your last bill (e.g. "24/07/2026 - 24/09/2026") and enter the day and whether periods start in odd (Jan, Mar, May…) or even (Feb, Apr, Jun…) months.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter password
reauth_confirm.description: The EAC portal rejected the password for {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the EAC portal. Try again later.
error.no_service_points: No supply is registered on this account.

options.odd: Odd months (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov)
options.even: Even months (Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec)
